name: Still ground
concept: Almost empty ink-navy field. Four exceptionally faint rectangular dark corner steps at outer margins only. No stars or bright marks. Wide quiet space. Intensity 1/10.
motion: Static; cut.

name: First light
concept: One fine dim horizontal rule at 82% canvas height, broken where the well covers it. Two broader darker under-bands, very sparse. Intensity 1.4/10.
motion: Static; 0.4s stepped fade.

name: Distant stars
concept: A sparse field of exactly 28 tiny 1px and 2px square stars concentrated toward outer margins. Empty near well; no bright dots under HUD. Intensity 1.8/10.
motion: Static; 0.5s stepped fade.

name: Quiet strata
concept: Eight broad uneven sediment bands, horizontal solid rectangles in very dark slate. Irregular stepped ends near outer edges, subtly denser than stars. Intensity 2.2/10.
motion: Static; 0.5s stepped fade.

name: Slow drift
concept: 56 square stars, 1px or 2px, outer margins. Sparse tiny rectangular dust flecks. Calm early motion feeling, no streaks. Intensity 2.6/10.
motion: One star layer drifts down at 2px/s; wrap; cut.

name: Dither dusk
concept: Restrained coarse checker dither patches at outer edges, built from 4px squares with wide empty gaps. Two dark tones form 5 stepped horizontal zones; no continuous noisy full-screen texture. Intensity 3/10.
motion: One patch layer drifts up at 2px/s; wrap; 0.5s fade.

name: Sleeping skyline
concept: Blocky rectilinear tower silhouettes rise from bottom corners, 14 towers of varied narrow widths and stepped rooftops. Tiny subdued square windows, no city illustration or glows. Landscape skyline remains far below HUD; portrait silhouettes live outer 72px strips and bottom margin. Intensity 3.4/10.
motion: Window accent layer pulses over 8s; static towers; 0.5s fade.

name: Low signal
concept: Horizontal dark scanline bands at 10px spacing, grouped into uneven lengths along outer margins; several understated solid bars near outer edges. Avoid bright or busy HUD zones. No typography in motif. Intensity 3.8/10.
motion: Single scanline layer scrolls down at 3px/s; wrap; cut.

name: Fracture
concept: Two stepped diagonal fractures made from connected thin horizontal/vertical rectangles down the far outer margins. Each fracture has a dark offset ledge and scarce dull blue-gray edge ticks. No center crossing. Intensity 4.2/10.
motion: One tick layer drifts down at 3px/s along fracture; 0.5s fade.

name: Circuit hush
concept: Fine orthogonal circuit traces and small square nodes at outer edges, 16 widely separated paths. No traces in well, no letters, no arrowheads. Broad clear zones behind HUD. Crisp dim technical geometry. Intensity 4.6/10.
motion: Node accent layer pulses over 7s; static traces; 0.5s fade.

name: Band aurora
concept: Three broad stacked aurora ribbons built strictly from flat stepped rectangular bands in desaturated navy/slate. Side edges cascade in staircase contours. No gradients or glowing sky, no real scenery. Intensity 5/10.
motion: One ribbon layer slides up at 4px/s; 96s loop; 0.6s fade.

name: Long trails
concept: Outer margin star field with 12 short staircase diagonal meteor trails made from 1x3px horizontal pixel steps. 72 dim square stars. Slow restrained directional energy; trails dim and no glow. Intensity 5.4/10.
motion: Single star-and-trail layer drifts diagonally at 4px/s total; wrap; cut.

name: Deep grid
concept: Stepped receding rectangular grid on far margins, 22 orthogonal staircase lines with decreasing spacing toward an imaginary horizon around mid-height. All diagonal parts visibly stair-stepped. Never intrude on board or overwhelm HUD. Intensity 5.8/10.
motion: One grid layer scrolls down at 5px/s; 80s loop; 0.6s fade.

name: Fine snow
concept: Dense but restrained 160 tiny 1px and 2px square snow-like particles, concentrated at outside edges. Dark secondary bands behind particle field. At most a handful of larger flecks; no atmospheric blur. Intensity 6.2/10.
motion: Single particle layer falls at 6px/s; wrap; cut.

name: Undertow
concept: Seven interlocking wave bands made of long horizontal rectangles and stepped bends. Two opposing static contour directions suggest currents, but all bands belong to one moving layer. Dense outer edges, dark open board-adjacent gaps. Intensity 6.6/10.
motion: Whole band layer slides left at 6px/s; 80s loop; 0.6s fade.

name: Slow pulse
concept: Nine nested broken rectangular contours frame the outside of the scene, clipped at outer edges. Thin stepped bars separated by dark negative space. Rectangular concentric pressure, never circular or neon. Intensity 7/10.
motion: One ring layer expands outward at 6px/s; 8s pulse; 0.6s fade.

name: Rising ember
concept: 190 tiny dim warm-gray square embers concentrate at far left and far right, with stepped dark block columns. Tiny restrained muted warm hints ONLY in accent pixels, all bases dark dull navy-charcoal. No flames, glow or orange washes. Intensity 7.7/10.
motion: One ember layer rises at 7px/s; wrap; cut.

name: Storm lines
concept: 200 short thin rectangular rain dashes mixed with a few longer stepped diagonal trails, all part of one dense outer-margin motif. Dim slate blue, clear well and quiet HUD. No realistic rain, lightning or glow. Intensity 8.4/10.
motion: One combined rain-and-trail layer falls at 8px/s; wrap; cut.

name: Compression
concept: Thirty broad broken rectangular bands press inward from all four edges, with progressively tighter spacing outside the protected HUD zones. Stepped corners, dense edge rhythm and scarce pale ticks. Board remains clear center of attention. Intensity 9.2/10.
motion: One band layer moves inward at 9px/s; 12s seamless cycle; 0.5s fade.

name: Collapse
concept: Maximum controlled energy: 280 tiny isolated rectangular debris fragments and layered stepped slabs packed along far outer edges. Clear dark near-board corridor and protected HUD. No tetromino clusters; debris mostly 1x3,2x5,3x7px rectangles with large gaps. Dense, sharply structured, no noise texture or bright flare. Intensity 10/10.
motion: One debris layer drifts downward at 10px/s; wrap; 0.6s fade.
